zh-CN.heading: 看看你的行业，可以从哪里开始
zh-CN.intro: 从一项重复、费时的工作开始评估。下面列的是可讨论的业务场景；相关案例只说明实际做过的工作，具体范围与费用在开始前确认。

items.name: 制造业
items.summary: 库存核对、重复录入、产品与操作资料
items.detail: 可以先梳理物料或成品的登记、规格表和操作说明，评估哪些重复录入或查找步骤值得改善。涉及生产设备或现有系统对接时，单独确认条件和范围。
items.case_note: 相关案例是洁具 B 端库存业务，供库存流程参考。

items.name: 电子商务
items.summary: 商品资料、客服辅助答疑、内容整理
items.detail: 可以从一类商品说明、常见售前问题或重复整理任务开始，评估资料统一、客服辅助和内容整理的做法。先看你目前使用的平台与工具，再确定实施范围。

items.name: 跨境电商
items.summary: 中英文产品展示、品牌资料、客服支持
items.detail: 可以先看产品和品牌资料如何做中英文展示、哪些咨询总在重复，以及内容如何维护。结合目标市场与现有渠道，评估一个小范围的改进。
items.case_note: 相关经验是品牌出海营销与客服协作，具体职责见案例。

items.name: 批发与零售
items.summary: 进出库、商品目录、单据核对
items.detail: 可以先挑一笔收货或出货记录，梳理登记、库存变动和核对过程，再评估重复提交、录错纠正和目录整理的处理办法。
items.case_note: 相关库存项目展示具体业务适配与交付，使用效果边界见案例。

items.name: 家具、家居与建材
items.summary: 产品规格展示、品牌网站、库存流程
items.detail: 可以从产品图片、型号、尺寸和规格的组织开始，也可以先看官网展示或库存登记中的一个卡点。品牌前台、后台维护和库存功能分别确认范围。
items.case_note: 已有家具品牌前台展示与扫码库存项目记录，完成范围分别说明。

items.name: 律所与专业服务
items.summary: 官网、资料查找、内部办公流程
items.detail: 可以先看客户如何了解服务并找到咨询入口，或员工如何查资料、处理重复办公任务。资料权限、人工确认和维护责任在合作前约定。
items.case_note: 相关案例为团队中的律所官网与 OA 开发经历，分工见详情。

items.name: 品牌与内容工作室
items.summary: 素材管理、文案配图、重复内容制作
items.detail: 可以先梳理素材放在哪里、哪些文案或配图反复制作、哪些内容需要人工审核，再评估现成工具或小范围开发是否适合。
items.case_note: 相关实践为团队品牌营销、内容与 AI 视频协作。

items.name: 公益机构
items.summary: 官网、项目展示、信息公开与资料整理
items.detail: 可以先梳理机构介绍、项目内容与信息公开的展示，也可以讨论日常资料整理。哪些内容可公开、谁负责更新，需要在实施前确认。
items.case_note: 相关实践为公益官网开发；具体职责和交付内容见案例。

en.heading: Where could we start in your industry?
en.intro: Start by assessing one repetitive, time-consuming task. These are scenarios we can discuss; linked projects show the work actually done. Scope and fees are agreed before implementation.

items.name: Manufacturing
items.summary: Inventory checks, repeated entry and product documentation
items.detail: We can start with material or finished-goods records, specification sheets and operating instructions to assess repeated entry or information lookup. Equipment connections and integrations with existing systems need a separate scope review.
items.case_note: The related project concerns inventory for a sanitaryware B2B business, offered as a workflow reference.

items.name: E-commerce
items.summary: Product information, support assistance and content organization
items.detail: We can assess one set of product descriptions, common presales questions or repetitive content tasks. Your current platform and tools determine which approaches are suitable and what implementation would involve.

items.name: Cross-border e-commerce
items.summary: Chinese and English product presentation, brand information and support
items.detail: We can review bilingual product and brand information, recurring customer questions and content maintenance. The target market and existing channels help define a small improvement to assess.
items.case_note: Related experience is in overseas brand marketing and customer support collaboration. Each case states my role.

items.name: Wholesale and retail
items.summary: Stock movements, product catalogs and record reconciliation
items.detail: We can trace one receipt or dispatch through data entry, stock changes and reconciliation, then assess duplicate submissions, corrections and catalog organization.
items.case_note: The related inventory project shows business adaptation and delivery. Its case states the limits of the usage evidence.

items.name: Furniture, home and building products
items.summary: Product specifications, brand websites and inventory workflows
items.detail: We can start with product images, model numbers, dimensions and specifications, or one difficulty in website presentation or stock recording. Public pages, content management and inventory functions have separate scopes.
items.case_note: Furniture brand presentation and barcode inventory projects are documented separately, with their completion scope stated.

items.name: Law firms and professional services
items.summary: Websites, information lookup and internal workflows
items.detail: We can review how clients find service information and a contact route, or how staff find documents and handle recurring tasks. Access permissions, human review and maintenance responsibilities are agreed before implementation.
items.case_note: Related work covers law-firm website and office-system development within a team. See each case for my responsibilities.

items.name: Brands and content studios
items.summary: Asset organization, copy, images and recurring content tasks
items.detail: We can review where assets are stored, which copy or images are repeatedly produced and what needs human approval, then assess existing tools or a small development task.
items.case_note: Related experience is collaborative brand marketing, content and AI video work.

items.name: Nonprofit organizations
items.summary: Websites, project information, public disclosures and documents
items.detail: We can review organization information, project presentation, public disclosures or recurring document tasks. What can be made public and who maintains it must be agreed before implementation.
items.case_note: Related work is nonprofit website development. The case describes my role and the delivered content.
